# Ad copy and format specs per platform

The creative agent writes to these limits. **Warning:** platforms change limits often. The performance marketer checks each platform's current spec page at the monthly review and updates this file.

| Platform | Field | Write to (shows in full) | Hard limit (approx.) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Meta | Primary text | 125 characters | longer text is cut with "See more" |
| Meta | Headline | 27 to 40 characters | 255 |
| Meta | Description | 25 characters | often hidden |
| LinkedIn single image | Intro text | 150 characters | 600 |
| LinkedIn single image | Headline | 70 characters | 200 |
| LinkedIn document ad | Pages | 3 to 10 pages free, then gate with a Lead Gen Form | file size limits per spec |
| TikTok | Ad text | 80 characters | 100 (Latin script) |
| Snapchat | Headline | 34 characters | 34 |
| Snapchat | Brand name | 25 characters | 25 |

## Formats to make for each concept

| Format | Ratio | Platforms |
|---|---|---|
| Vertical video, 9 to 30 seconds | 9:16 | Meta Reels and Stories, TikTok, Snapchat |
| Feed video | 4:5 | Meta feed, LinkedIn |
| Square image or video | 1:1 | Meta, LinkedIn |
| Carousel (3 to 5 cards) | 1:1 or 4:5 | Meta, LinkedIn |

## Copy rules

1. Put the hook in the first line or the first 3 seconds.
2. Keep the 9:16 safe zone clear: no text in the top 14% and bottom 35% of the frame, where the platform shows its own buttons.
3. Captions on every video. Most people watch without sound.
4. 1 call to action per ad.
5. Arabic: write natively, right to left. Check that numbers and Latin brand names show in the correct order.
6. Quebec: French first. An English version is optional.
